selected_records.title: Social Pain Disrupts Emotion-Action Brain-State Dynamics in Adolescents with Non-Suicidal Self-Injury

article.body:
ArXiv record lists paper on social pain and brain-state dynamics in adolescents

An arXiv cs.AI record dated Oct. 8, 2026, lists a paper titled “Social Pain Disrupts Emotion-Action Brain-State Dynamics in Adolescents with Non-Suicidal Self-Injury.”

The available record provides no authors, abstract, methods or study results. It therefore does not establish what evidence the paper presents or how its title’s claim was assessed.
